failure_signature: RuntimeError: Input type (CUDABFloat16Type) and weight type (CPUBFloat16Type) should be the same
failure_location: step1002 Critic rollout, Generator patch_embedding Conv3d
root_cause: After GAN-active step1001, Score remained GPU-resident because EMA was correctly skipped above ema_start_step. The wave-swap Critic entry assumed Generator was already resident, so the next rollout consumed CUDA latents with Generator non-streamed state still on CPU. Earlier pre-EMA workloads masked this missing transition because EMA swapped Generator back after every step.
matching_prior_failure: none found; this control-flow edge is specific to GAN-active Critic-only steps above ema_start_step
validated_repair: Before Critic rollout, inspect only non-streamed model parameters; if Generator compute state is not on the target device, perform the existing Score-to-Generator wave swap. Streamed frozen blocks remain intentionally CPU-backed and are excluded from the predicate.
